properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the approved 41-story tower as six steps, set out from the dimensioned floor plans in the 2025 Draft EIR (165 ft wide, narrowing from 96 ft 6 in deep at the hotel floors to 60 ft at the top), to its roof at about 544 ft, with the east end of its three-story base; and the four-story, 55-ft Fire Station 13 on the 447 Battery Street lot. The rooftop screen to 574 ft is not drawn.
properties.note: The approved buildings as simple stepped volumes, not the final design.

georeference.method: Plan offsets laid out from the Sansome Street / Washington Street corner of the DataSF parcels for the tower (0206/013, 014, 017), along their two frontages.

properties.license: Dimensions: from a public SF Planning document. Lots: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.use: Lobbies, drop-off and loading, ballroom and meeting rooms

properties.note: The east end of the three-story base, which reaches farther east than the tower above it, over the drive-through drop-off and the loading dock off Washington Street.

properties.note: A four-story replacement for Fire Station 13, about 55 ft tall (60 ft to the top of its rooftop amenity space and equipment), with one basement level. The developer builds it for the City; the existing station at 530 Sansome Street stays in service until it's done.
